script: Beavers live in freshwater ecosystems such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds across the landscape. River ecosystems are flowing waters that drain the landscape and include living interactions amongst many parts. The major zones in river ecosystems are determined by the river bed gradient or current velocity. In Europe, beavers were reduced to fragmented populations with combined population numbers estimated in areas. The concept became popular in conservation and was deployed in a range of contexts for support. Human activities had damaged ecosystems such as by removing keystone predators from the natural landscape.
